newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cautious Australian stocks little changed at open.
newsitem.headline: Cautious Australian stocks little changed at open.

text.p: The Australian share market was barely moved at the open on Thursday as the cautious mood from Wednesday afternoon continued to hold sway.
The All Ordinaries index faded 1.7 points to 2,486.3.
While Wall Street's advance above the 7,000 level for the first time in nearly seven weeks was taken on board by brokers, local investors were more reluctant to jump in.
"Our market is a lot more cautious," said dealer at Reynolds and Co, Peter Struk, adding that the near-term outlook for the Australian market was still positive.
"We just keep going up nicely and I think we will continue to do so."
The leaders were mostly off several cents in choppy, nondescript trade.

Features in a quiet day so far included drug developer Cortecs International, up 22 cents to A$5.82 (US$4.54), albeit in thin trade, as it awaited the results of its 'Macritonin' osteoporosis treatment, due by May 2.
Falls shaded rises just by a whisker, while about 43 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
